prompts.opponent:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: faithful photorealistic pixel-art restoration of the Stunts opponent-selection biography background.
Input image: the ORIGINAL GAME BACKGROUND, 320x182, is the edit target and authoritative composition. Restore it at 1280x728 (exactly 4x width and height). Preserve the entire raw pixel aspect, no display aspect correction.
Primary request: resolve the existing low-resolution illustration into crisp, carefully controlled photorealistic pixel art, staying very close to the original objects, camera, boundaries, positions and color palette. Do not redesign the scene.

LAYOUT, critical:
A top-down desktop still life. Left approximately 201/320 of image: nearly black/dark reddish-brown clipboard backing, a large flat light-gray BLANK sheet from original x8..190 and y6..181. Same straight paper edges. At paper's upper-left corner a thin bent gold/brass paperclip, angled down-right, occupying only original x4..34,y0..30. At paper's upper center a small gold/yellow metal clipboard clamp at original x60..143,y0..21, with its exact original silhouette. Faint pale tire-tread imprint rises diagonally along only the lower left margin, from original x8,y41 to x77,y181; preserve its scale and opacity.
Keep the paper's broad central/right area perfectly clean and UNIFORM light gray (approximately RGB222,222,222). No texture, shading gradients, grain, noise, handwriting, printed text, portrait, photo, name or biography on this paper. The game overlays its portrait and biography here. Do not introduce a photo frame or placeholder.
Right approximately x202..319: warm orange-brown wood tabletop with fine restrained wood grain matching the original's horizontal grain and knots.
A round blue-cased analog stopwatch with white face and tiny dark tick marks sits around original x208..270,y45..114. Preserve its original size, circular shape, hand positions (slim red hand toward upper right) and modest metallic edge. Crisp readable mechanism, not a new large modern watch.
Behind the stopwatch retain the existing slender diagonal yellow/gold shaft with pink/red upper tip from near original (244,5) toward (286,132), at exactly the original angle and thickness. Retain the dark looped cord that winds from the upper-right edge down beside the stopwatch; trace its original path, do not add loops or extra straps.
At bottom-right retain the original small pile of car keys: a long silver key projects diagonally toward the bottom-left; black angular key heads overlap around original x246..295,y135..177; the red rounded key fob with blue circular white emblem is partly cropped by the right and bottom edges. Preserve their original overlap, orientations, silhouettes and scale.

STYLE: realistic brass, wood, blue enamel, steel and black plastic interpreted in crisp clean pixel-art clusters. Add restrained material definition inside existing object silhouettes, no random grain, no excessive microtexture, no blur, no painterly strokes, no dithering. Large blank paper area MUST remain homogeneous gray.
Constraints: keep exact original full image framing, clipboard/table division, all object placements and proportions. No new objects, no extra keys, no text anywhere, no opponents, no portraits, no biography, no user-interface buttons or controls, no added border, no padding, no crop/perspective shift. This background ends at source y182; do not invent the game's bottom 18-pixel button strip. Output only the restored background.
prompts.main:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: restored Stunts main menu background, full-bleed 1280 x 800 pixel working image (exactly 4 times the source 320 x 200 dimensions).
Input image: the attached original main menu is the edit target and the authoritative layout.
Primary request: Faithful high-detail restoration of this exact image as photorealistic pixel art. Resolve the missing visual detail imaginatively but conservatively: realistic mountain rock and snow, trees, grass, water, bridge materials and glossy blue car, all expressed in clean deliberate pixel art. The scene must remain instantly recognizable as the same 1991 racing-game menu.
Composition invariants: preserve the entire framing and all object positions. Same black and yellow diagonal striped border on all four sides. Same bright cyan blue sky and fluffy white clouds, snowy mountain range, red suspension bridge in upper middle-left, lake on right, green roadside terrain and trees. Same winding dark asphalt road with yellow center dashes, curving left toward the bridge. Same blue sports car viewed from behind at bottom center with dark rear window. Same four roadside signs at exactly their original screen locations and sizes: blue circular Car sign on left, red octagonal Opponent sign at bottom left, orange inverted triangular Track sign at upper right, green rectangular Option sign at bottom right. Preserve the small bottom-center STUNTS plate.
Text (verbatim): "Car", "Opponent", "Track", "Option", "Let's Drive", "STUNTS". Keep the same placement as original, Let's Drive on two centered lines in the car's rear window. Keep clear high-contrast simple white pixel lettering.
Style: photorealistic materials and lighting interpreted through crisp pixel-art clusters, rich but source-faithful colors, no painterly strokes, no blur, no film grain or random speckles. View is the exact original game illustration camera; do not turn this into a new photographic composition.
Constraints: no added objects, no new UI, no text changes, no extra cars or people, no crop, no padding, no perspective shift, no watermarks. Preserve original raw 8:5 pixel aspect composition; do not apply VGA display aspect correction. Restore finer detail inside the existing silhouettes.
